entities.summary: Priest and scribe who led the second wave of Jewish exiles from Babylon to Jerusalem (c. 458 BCE). He publicly read and interpreted the Torah, reestablishing its centrality in Jewish life and is traditionally credited with canonizing much of the Hebrew Bible.
